component.title: Drag
component.purpose: Normalizes pointer movement for drag consumers and gives every gesture a keyboard equivalent.

states.description: Escape ends the drag without committing.
Disabled controllers ignore every entry point.

claims.statement: Space or Enter starts a drag, arrows move it by step (coarseStep with Shift), Enter commits and Escape cancels.
Returned handlers keep a stable identity across renders even when the caller passes an inline options object.
The disabled flag is honoured on pointer down, move and up as well as on key down.
